messages:
maria gonzalez: Quick handoff — I'm primary until 07:00 PT tomorrow. Leaving notes below, please ack and raise if you don't have access to anything listed.

maria gonzalez: Open items: 1) INC-2345 (high latency on embedding service) — mitigation in progress, scaled pool to 3x. 2) Grafana alerts for redis miss spike still noisy. 3) APAC night coverage gap 00:00-04:00 UTC needs primary.

IncidentBot: page INC-2345 created by svc-telemetry at 1799123100 — symptom: increased p99 latency for embeddings. Assigned to maria gonzalez.

alex kim: ack. I can take on APAC night if I get pagerduty escalate rights and Grafana read+edit for the dashboards under team/inference. Right now I only have read.

maria gonzalez: @alex noted. You currently aren't on the PagerDuty escalation policy for prod_incidents_escalation — @ops-admin can you add alex to secondary? Also need to confirm Grafana role.

ops-admin: I can add you to PD. Which PD user email?

alex kim: alex@redwood.dev — thanks. Also Grafana org is redwood-prod, dashboard path: /d/embedding-service/latency. I need edit to silence alert transforms while we tune patterns.

jordan lee: @alex if you don't get grafana edit in time, I can proxy edits (will need to be online at handoff). But we should instead use a temporary role: assume-role approach in AWS so you can rotate creds and patch dashboards via infra API.

jordan lee: aws account: 987654321012. Quick assume snippet (only for on-call):
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::987654321012:role/OncallGrafanaEdit --role-session-name oncall-alex --duration-seconds 3600
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=...\nexport AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=...\nexport AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=...
```

maria gonzalez: That role is pre-provisioned for emergency edits. Ops-admin — can you approve adding alex to that role (temporary) and PD escalation? We need both before the handoff window.

ops-admin: Approving now. I'll add alex@redwood.dev to the prod_incidents_escalation as secondary and attach the OncallGrafanaEdit role for 2h sessions. Confirm when done.

ops-admin: Done for PD (you should receive invite). OncallGrafanaEdit role attached with 2h session limit. Also opened ticket TKT-5480 with audit link: https://redwood-ops.atlassian.net/browse/TKT-5480.

alex kim: got the PD invite, can escalate. Trying assume-role now — success, can edit dashboard. Can someone confirm I should mute the redis_miss spike alert (rule id: redis_miss_spike) or reroute to lower severity?

maria gonzalez: Hold on muting until we check downstream. For INC-2345 mitigation, keep scaling. If latency falls below 250ms p99 for 10m, mute threshold to avoid flapping. I'll post back with numbers in 10m.

alex kim: ack. Also note APAC coverage — I'll take the primary shift 00:00-04:00 UTC for tomorrow. Jordan will be backup. Maria, please post the final handoff message when you leave.

maria gonzalez: Final: handing off primary -> @alex for 00:00-04:00 UTC APAC. Primary checklist: PD escalation verified, Grafana edit via assume-role tested, runbook link: https://redwood-infra.runbooks/handbook/oncall-handoff (follow PD + Grafana sections), AWS account 987654321012, incident INC-2345 in progress. If anything new pages, escalate via prod_incidents_escalation and notify #eng-oncall.

alex kim: Thanks — acknowledged. Good handoff. :thumbsup:

jordan lee: noted. I'll be reachable as backup. Leaving a quick runbook pointer for future handoffs: add new oncall to PagerDuty before handoff, test assume-role, verify Grafana Dashboard edit via the infra API, confirm audit ticket created.

IncidentBot: INC-2345 updated by maria gonzalez — mitigation: scaled workers to 3x; next review at +10m.

maria gonzalez: leaving now. Good luck team, ping me if anything critical.
